sources.title: 2026 Q2 Form 10-Q
sources.excerpt: Q2 2026 total revenue 112,032 million versus 111,616; net earnings attributable to common shareholders 5,484 versus 3,406; diluted EPS 6.04 versus 3.74. Q2 MCR 86.7% versus 89.4%. Medical cost trend remains above historical levels affected by No Surprises Act provider reimbursement and service/coding intensity. Lower MCR reflects favorable prior-period reserve development, affordability, medical management and pricing. Fewer people served in Medicare Advantage/commercial risk/Medicaid and fewer Optum value-based patients partly offset pricing. June 30 cash 28,585; current debt 3,827 plus long debt 69,501 million. RADV audits may adjust retrospective payments. 2017 DOJ False Claims Act case: March 2025 special master recommends summary judgment for company, DOJ objects April 2025; outcome cannot be estimated. March 6 2026 IRS proposed adjustments for 2017-2020 foreign transfer pricing, company contests.

sources.title: Court approves UnitedHealth Amedisys settlement
sources.excerpt: December 10 2025, updated April 15 2026. Court entered final judgment resolving challenge to $3.3 billion Amedisys acquisition. Requires at least 164 home health and hospice locations across 19 states, about $528 million annual revenue, to be divested; monitor appointed; eight additional facilities conditionally. Amedisys pays $1.1 million civil penalty for falsely certifying HSR responses. DOJ describes UNH as vertically integrated insurer/provider/PBM/software vendor.

timing.alignment_note: FY2025 GAAP diluted EPS is assumed a conservative present earning-capacity proxy, not claimed to be current trailing or forward EPS. Five annual growth steps begin2026-10-11 and end2031-10-11; exit multiple applies to hypothetical terminal trailing EPS. No extra growth period is silently added for the elapsed fiscal year. Normalization deliberately excludes observed newer EPS to avoid temporary quarter/reserve effects; no factual earnings bridge is implied.
